_doc: THE ENGINE THIS CONTRACT MODULE'S CLIENT BINDS (#871, engine-apk-split move 8). Same shape as libs:analytics' declaration, here because the client lives here: the SuperApp and C3 compile libs:ops (the Dagu page, the bearer storage and this client) and neither compiles the ops engine that makes the HTTPS calls. `fleet` is the Store row in aa_cloud-superapp/data/constellation-fleet.json from which build.gradle resolves the package (an unknown id fails the build) into BuildConfig and the merged <queries>; `action` finds the service ({package} substituted at build time, matching the engine manifest's ${applicationId}.ENGINE); `min_contract` is the lowest engine CONTRACT that answers every method OpsLink calls, read through PackageManager BEFORE binding. With the engine absent the page shows the sentence that says what to install, never a crash.
